# CLI11

[CLI11](https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11) 2.4.2, the command-line parser of the tool `miniverse` (tools/), kept here as
its authors publish it, unchanged:

- `CLI11.hpp`: the single header of the release, https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11/releases/download/v2.4.2/CLI11.hpp.
- `LICENSE`: its license, BSD 3-Clause, from the release's source tree. The same notice heads `CLI11.hpp`.

The license asks that its copyright notice stay with the source, and that a binary made from it carry the notice in
what comes with it: installing the tool installs `LICENSE` beside miniverse's own, as `CLI11-LICENSE` in the docs
directory (`share/doc/miniverse/`).

To update it, replace both files with a later release's and change the version above.
